title: Pivot Clearing Preserves Satisfaction
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a linear equation over $mathbb{F}_2$, and let $R$ be a finite list of such equations. Fix an assignment that satisfies $p$. Clearing the coefficient of a chosen variable in every equation of $R$ by adding $p$ whenever that coefficient is nonzero preserves satisfaction of the list: the assignment satisfies the resulting list if and only if it satisfies $R$.
